title: Palindrome Number
question: Given an integer x, return true if x is a palindrome (reads same forwards and backwards). Negative numbers are not palindromes.
optimal_explanation: Convert to string, compare with reverse. O(log n) time.

title: Roman to Integer
question: Given a roman numeral string, convert it to integer. Roman numerals: I=1, V=5, X=10, L=50, C=100, D=500, M=1000.
optimal_explanation: Process left to right. If current < next, subtract. Else add. O(n) time.

title: Longest Common Prefix
question: Write a function to find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings. Return '' if there is no common prefix.
hints: Compare character by character with all others.
optimal_explanation: Use first string as prefix, shrink until all strings start with it. O(S) time where S = total chars.

title: Move Zeroes
question: Given an array nums, move all 0s to the end while maintaining the relative order of non-zero elements. Do it in-place.
hints: Two pointers: one for position to insert non-zero.
Scan and place non-zeros at front.
optimal_explanation: Two-pointer. Place non-zeros at front, fill rest with zeros. O(n) time, O(1) space.

title: Single Number
question: Given a non-empty array where every element appears twice except one, find that single element. Must be O(n) time O(1) space.
hints: XOR of a number with itself = 0.
XOR of a number with 0 = the number.
XOR all numbers — pairs cancel out.
optimal_solution:
def solve(nums):
    result = 0
    for n in nums: result ^= n
    return result
optimal_explanation: XOR all numbers. Pairs cancel (a^a=0). Single number remains. O(n) time, O(1) space.

title: Palindrome Linked List
question: Given a linked list as array, determine if it is a palindrome.
hints: Simple: convert to array and check.
Optimal: find middle, reverse second half, compare.
optimal_explanation: Compare list with its reverse. For real linked list, reverse second half. O(n) time.

title: Balanced Binary Tree
question: Given a binary tree as level-order list, determine if it is height-balanced (depth of subtrees never differs by more than 1).
hints: DFS to get height of each subtree.
optimal_explanation: DFS. Return -1 if unbalanced subtree found. O(n) time, O(h) space.

title: Letter Combinations of Phone Number
question: Given a string of digits 2-9, return all possible letter combinations. Phone mapping: 2=abc, 3=def, 4=ghi, 5=jkl, 6=mno, 7=pqrs, 8=tuv, 9=wxyz.
hints: For each digit, try all mapped letters.
optimal_explanation: Backtracking. For each digit, iterate mapped letters and recurse. O(4^n × n) time.

title: Majority Element
question: Given array nums of size n, return the majority element (appears more than n/2 times). Guaranteed to exist.
optimal_explanation: Boyer-Moore Voting. Track candidate and count. Majority survives all cancellations. O(n) time, O(1) space.

title: Spiral Matrix
question: Given an m×n matrix, return all elements in spiral order.
hints: Use four boundaries: top, bottom, left, right.
Traverse right, down, left, up, shrink boundaries.
optimal_explanation: Four boundaries. Traverse each side, shrink. O(m×n) time, O(1) space.
